policies.title: Standard Refund Policy
policies.content: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after the returned item is received and inspected, or after an approved cancellation.
policies.eligibility: Customers with an approved return, an approved cancellation, or a damaged, defective or incorrect item.
conditions: Refund requests must be submitted within 30 days of delivery.
Shipping fees are non-refundable unless the item was damaged or incorrect.
The time to appear on the statement depends on the customer's bank or card issuer.

policies.title: Refunds for Damaged or Incorrect Items
policies.content: If an item arrives damaged, defective or different from the order, the customer can receive a refund or a replacement.
policies.eligibility: Items that arrive damaged, defective or different from what was ordered.
conditions: Photos of the item and its packaging must be provided.
The issue must be reported within 7 days of delivery.
A replacement may be offered instead of a refund if stock is available.

policies.title: Standard Return Policy
policies.content: Most unused items may be returned within 30 days of delivery in their original packaging.
policies.eligibility: Customers with a delivered order that is still inside the 30-day return window.
conditions: The item must be unused and in its original condition.
Original packaging and accessories must be included.
Return shipping is free for defective items. Otherwise the customer pays the return shipping.

policies.title: Non-Returnable Items
policies.content: Some items cannot be returned for hygiene, safety or personalisation reasons.
policies.eligibility: Items in the restricted categories listed below.
conditions: Opened personal care products.
Custom or personalised orders.
Digital gift cards.

policies.title: Shipping Times and Options
policies.content: Standard shipping usually takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping usually takes 1 to 2 business days. Delivery times start once the order has been dispatched.
policies.eligibility: All orders placed on the store.
conditions: Delivery estimates may change because of carrier delays.
Orders placed after 2 PM are dispatched on the next business day.

policies.title: Delivery Address Changes
policies.content: A delivery address can be changed only before the order has been handed over to the carrier.
policies.eligibility: Orders that have not yet been handed over to the carrier (Processing status).
conditions: The customer must provide the order ID and the new address.
Once the order is Shipped or Out for Delivery, the address cannot be changed.

policies.title: Order Cancellation
policies.content: Orders can be cancelled free of charge while they are in Processing status.
policies.eligibility: Customers who request cancellation before the order has shipped.
conditions: Orders with status Shipped, Out for Delivery or Delivered cannot be cancelled. Use the return process instead.
Refunds for cancelled orders are issued within 5 to 7 business days.

policies.title: Declined Payments and Duplicate Charges
policies.content: If a payment is declined or a customer is charged twice for the same order, the duplicate charge is reversed after verification.
policies.eligibility: Customers reporting a declined payment or a duplicate charge on an order.
conditions: Verification requires the order ID and the last four digits of the card.
Duplicate charges are reversed within 2 business days after verification.
Bank processing times vary and can take 3 to 10 business days to appear.
